description: ECS Fargate AZ Evacuation - Drills the operator/automation response to an AZ impairment: injects the fault, waits for a detection delay, then evacuates the AZ by removing its subnet from the ECS service, forcing all tasks into the remaining healthy AZs.

disrupt-az-connectivity.description: Deny intra-VPC traffic between the target subnet and subnets in other Availability Zones, simulating an AZ network partition

inject-network-packet-loss.description: Injects 100% packet loss for tasks in the target availability zone

wait-before-stop.description: Wait 1 minute for packet loss and connectivity disruption to take effect before stopping tasks

stop-tasks-in-az.description: Stop all ECS Fargate tasks running in the target availability zone

wait-for-detection.description: Detection delay: simulates the time it takes for an operator or automated alarm to detect the AZ impairment and decide to evacuate. Adjust to match your real detection SLA.

evacuate-subnet-in-az.description: Evacuates the AZ by removing its subnet from the ECS service network configuration, forcing all tasks (including those already stopped and any replacements) into the remaining healthy AZs. Restores the subnet automatically at the end of the evacuation window or on cancel/failure.
